passages.gloss: Dish alignment raises gain and resolution, while cloud water raises noise and lowers confidence in the source.
Display-lamp heat dries a parchment manuscript until fibres embrittle, pages crack and conservators must repair more.
Greater lint coverage removes latent defects, preventing incidents and operator fatigue while sustaining release frequency.
Road salt favours salt-tolerant grass over native sedge, while saline litter from the grass strengthens its own advantage.
Greater bat activity reduces insects, limiting leaf damage and tree stress while preserving fruit yield.
An external influence favours option A over B, while a reinforcing response gives A a further advantage.
Kiln temperature increases glaze fluidity and edge pooling, while faster cooling independently increases crazing.
More bat foraging suppresses moths, reducing canopy feeding and orchard stress, protecting fruit set.
In a malfunctioning unit, excessive runtime ices the coils and reduces moisture removal.
A seed library carrying more suitable seeds gives reliable harvests, drawing members who donate more packets.
Greater variety availability improves planting fit, raising success, participation and contributions, expanding variety further.
A growing deviation produces a stronger control signal, increasing corrective action and a counteracting effect.
A system with more diversity may offer better options, improve outcomes, attract participants and receive resources.
In a poorly curated exchange, excessive variety discourages participation and mixed contributions reduce planting fit.
School contact promotes formal orthography, competing with vernacular and reinforced by instructor praise.
Institutional exposure favours standard spelling; standard and dialect displace one another; teacher approval reinforces standard.
In a dialect-inclusive programme, exposure raises approval of dialect spelling and the two varieties reinforce rather than suppress.
A stronger early safeguard reduces hidden problems, preventing later disruption and strain while maintaining output.
Rising humidity strengthens the humidistat signal, extending dehumidifier runtime and moisture removal until humidity falls.
Wetter gallery air makes the sensor demand more from the drying unit, which extracts water and brings moisture back down.
A heavy fruit yield supports more insects, attracting bats that reduce leaf damage and one source of tree stress.
As a stock depletes, regulators tighten quotas, reducing effort and harvest pressure so depletion slows.
A driver project supporting more devices gains users, whose adoption and bug reports attract maintainers who add more device support.
Volcanic ash on a runway increases abrasion, accelerating tyre wear, raising landing risk and closures.
